verdict.comment: The mare HURT YOU NEVER made it 2-2 at Hamilton when winning over C&D two starts ago and gets the nod ahead of Digital.

comments.digital: Major question mark regarding current form but he won twice over C&D last year
comments.hurtyounever: Below par at Carlisle last time but 2-2 here and could bounce back with a bold show
comments.illusionist: Didn't run badly on AW last month when back from absence and is below last winning mark
comments.minniewildes: Won first two starts but hasn't threatened in either handicap; non-runner
comments.orbitalchime: Shaped as though he may have needed his reappearance; on a handy mark; slow ground suits
comments.orientalprince: Five AW wins this year and off the mark on turf at Haydock last time; respected up 3lb
comments.parisiac: Down to a dangerous mark but soundly beaten on his four outings this year
comments.popstar: A return to form is needed but rain may help and he's from an in-form yard

races.raceComment: hurtyounever is marginally preferred with a score of 57.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over orientalprince. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.dandysangel: Five C&D wins; weights chance but possibly of more interest when cheekpieces refitted

verdict.comment: The one who appeals most is HOSTELRY, who comes here in fine form and, although 3lb higher than at Hamilton, remains on a handy mark.

comments.distinction: Won this race last year but patchy form since July and may prefer softer ground
comments.drrio: Versatile sort trip-wise who likes it at this venue; needs to better this year's form
comments.hostelry: In good form this season and should go well from 3lb higher mark
comments.madameplaintiff: Disappointing after winning last April but shaped well last time (yard debut); big chance
comments.mistrollinin: Yet to win and well beaten on stable debut/reappearance on AW last time; more needed
comments.panamacity: Infrequent turf winner but ran well at Ripon last week; claims from the same mark
comments.pennyghent: Inconsistent maiden; should be better for recent reappearance but needs to raise game
comments.phoenixfire: Heavy ground winner in 2022 but hasn't added to tally; mainly disappointing last year
comments.veryclassy: Moderate maiden who hasn't been out for over a year; best watched on first run for trainer

races.raceComment: hostelry is marginally preferred with a score of 57.5%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over drrio. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 4 wins from 32 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The one who appeals most is ASTAPOR, who ran well when last seen in March and should be suited by this stiff venue.

comments.araifjan: Infrequent winner and, although a respectable run last time, may find a few too strong
comments.astapor: Shaped well after a break on AW last time and return to this stiffer venue should suit
comments.beneficiary: Multiple AW winner; yet to win on turf and below best of late; others make more appeal
comments.blackcurrent: Bulk of wins have been at Newcastle and best watched on first turf run since 2023
comments.desertmaster: Triple AW winner who has yet to win on grass and needs to raise game
comments.fortunatestar: Knows how to win and ran well in race that has been franked at Catterick; should go well
comments.goldenrainbow: Six wins last year on turf/AW and ran well last time (form franked); should go well
comments.gypsynation: Yet to win and, although he ran respectably last time, has work to do from wide draw
comments.ifonlytheycudtalk: Infrequent winner who needs to better this year's form if he's to get back to winning ways
comments.ladybouquet: C&D winner last June; satisfactory return at Hamilton and isn't without a chance
comments.mrstrump: Form since last win has a patchy look to it and she may again find one or two too good
comments.soldiersdesign: Maiden winner at Brighton last summer but below that level since; others appeal more
comments.stallone: Has had plenty of chances since last win over a year ago and may prefer softer ground

races.raceComment: fortunatestar is marginally preferred with a score of 52.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings over ladybouquet. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

going: GOOD, Good to firm in places (GoingStick: 7.0) (Watered) (Rail Movements: 2.18 +42yds, 2.48 +53yds, 3.18 & 4.48 +12yds, 3.48 +18yds and 4.18 +62yds) (Showers)

verdict.comment: Plenty have possibilities but the vote goes to James Owen's resurgent hat-trick seeker KINETIC (nap). Silver Nightfall is feared.

comments.aiminghigh: Had tough task at Ascot latest and was in good form on AW before that; in the mix
comments.chilliqueen: Won a Wolverhampton maiden latest and she's open to more progress on handicap debut
comments.elterwater: Won three in a row on AW this year but was held over C&D last time; needs to find more
comments.kinetic: Back in the groove with wins in last two starts and highly respected in hat-trick bid
comments.lessonoflife: Unexposed handicap newcomer and she needs a close look in the market
comments.missdollyrocker: Reliable sort but she looks weighted near best off this mark and has tough draw back on AW
comments.morethanafeelin: Out of sorts in her three runs this year and has stamina to prove at this new trip
comments.nowhere: Reached the frame in last three runs but she's now 0-9 and needs to find something extra
comments.personalbest: Leicester winner who is unexposed and needs a close look on her handicap debut
comments.silvernightfall: Record of 22121 since wearing a visor and is 5-16 on AW; respected back from a break
comments.typicalwoman: Triple turf winner but she's 1-12 on AW and was well held over C&D on recent return
comments.vilaineverlaine: Dual AW winner who still has potential and looks interesting on this step up to 1m4f

races.raceComment: kinetic is marginally preferred with a score of 55.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over silvernightfall. Won 2 of last 6 starts. comments.drwaksman: 0-8 on the Flat and over hurdles; will do well to break his duck in this company
comments.duetohenry: Half-brother to a couple of AW winners, but this looks a tough task on his reappearance
comments.federated: Poor last time, but usually consistent and 2-2 over C&D; each-way claims if bouncing back
comments.forestgate: Half-brother to a US dirt winner, but he has a bit to prove on his return
comments.haku: Dual C&D winner; penalty for recent Wolverhampton win puts him back on a career-high mark
comments.kotari: 2lb below last winning mark but something to prove on his first AW run since French debut
comments.melekalreeh: Was returning from 180 days off when just beaten at Doncaster last month; respected
comments.siemprearturo: 5-10 last year, but has suffered two heavy defeats on turf since returning last month
comments.trojanstorm: Won at Wolverhampton last time; a bit to prove back on Polytrack after 109 days off
comments.turquino: Won twice on Tapeta before disappointing on turf; major player if resuming his progress
comments.wayoflife: 2lb higher than for latest success over 1m3f here, but others are preferred for the win

verdict.comment: Dual C&D winner LERMOOS LEGEND returns here after a good recent effort and remains on a workable mark, so his claims look solid.

comments.ascensionday: Placed a few times over hurdles but his two chasing attempts did not go well; stable debut
comments.chantillyrose: Didn't run badly at Hexham last week but is effectively 5lb higher here
comments.couldbeaweapon: Well held over 3m last time but made quite encouraging stable debut over 2m3f
comments.duskydays: Form nosedived after last May's Stratford win; back from break for new stable
comments.eljefe: Out of form over hurdles last season; makes rather belated chase debut today
comments.enselduperche: Ended last season in good form and won over C&D on only previous Cartmel visit
comments.importateur: 0-5 over hurdles; makes stable/chase debut after 422-day absence; 4lb wrong
comments.judicialreview: 2m5f course winner last summer; tailed off over 3m1f here on Saturday; hard to predict
comments.lermooslegend: Dual C&D winner; returns here after good second in higher-grade race last month
comments.neighbotha: Below form over hurdles last month but ran well in a chase two starts ago; a possible
comments.robinsfield: 0-22 under all codes but ran big race when second in this contest a year ago
comments.shillanavogy: Second to rejuvenated subsequent winner last time; contender if drop back in trip suits
comments.swordoffate: Triple C&D winner; lurks on a dangerous mark but has been out of form this spring

races.raceComment: lermooslegend is confidently preferred with a score of 61.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over swordoffate. verdict.comment: Excused his defeat over 2m4f on good ground this month, thorough stayer AUTONOMOUS CLOUD ought to be much better suited by this test.

comments.autonomouscloud: Useful stayer; found 2m4f on good ground too sharp last time; can fare much better here
comments.firstlorddecuet: Badly out of form under rules last season but easily won a point on latest outing in March
comments.galileosilver: In very good form in points in recent weeks; can make presence felt on hunter chase debut
comments.greatnotions: Held on gamely for Hexham win this month but contests a stronger race here
comments.lineleeking: Useful handicapper who won on hunter chase debut in March; leading contender
comments.shantoumoon: Modest second in four-runner hunter chase at Perth this month; others looks stronger here
comments.torngat: Out of form this year and faces a tough assignment here

races.raceComment: autonomouscloud is marginally preferred with a score of 47.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and superior course form and more progressive over shantoumoon. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include superior ratings, though inconsistent profile need consideration.
